summary: Woori Financial Group Inc., a Korean bank holding company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution recommending a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 220 per common share (record date Aug 10, 2026; payout Aug 31, 2026). The total dividend amount is KRW 160,167,862,140 based on 728,035,737 outstanding shares. The dividend is paid from capital reserve reduction and treated as non-taxable return of capital under Korean tax law. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine dividend declaration by a foreign private issuer. Watch for potential changes to the payout date per discussions with relevant institutions.
